title: Directed Noetherian local model towers
statement: Let $R,S,T$ be commutative rings with ring maps $R\to S\to T$, and let $M$ be a $T$-module with a specified restricted $S$-action. A Noetherian local model tower consists of a nonempty directed preorder $I$; for each $i\in I$, commutative Noetherian local rings $R_i,S_i,T_i$ [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], local homomorphisms $R_i\to S_i\to T_i$, and a finite $T_i$-module $N_i$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] with its restricted $S_i$- and $R_i$-actions. For $i\le j$ it has local ring transitions $r_{ji},s_{ji},t_{ji}$ and additive transitions $n_{ji}$, equal to identities at equal indices and compatible with composition; ring squares commute and $n_{ji}(ax)=t_{ji}(a)n_{ji}(x)$. There are compatible local maps $R_i\to R,S_i\to S,T_i\to T$ commuting with the two horizontal ring maps, and compatible additive maps $\nu_i:N_i\to M$ semilinear over $T_i\to T$. Every element of each limit ring and $M$ is the image of a stage element, and equality of two elements at one stage whose limit images coincide holds at a later stage. For $i\le j$ the canonical maps $T_i\otimes_{R_i}R_j\to T_j$ and $T_i\otimes_{S_i}S_j\to T_j$, $a\otimes b\mapsto t_{ji}(a)b$, are localizations at some multiplicative subsets, and $T_j\otimes_{T_i}N_i\to N_j$, $a\otimes x\mapsto a n_{ji}(x)$, is a linear isomorphism. Finally for every $i$ there is a submonoid $U\subseteq R\otimes_{R_i}S_i$ with an $R$-linear isomorphism $U^{-1}(R\otimes_{R_i}S_i)\cong S$, and a module structure of $C=S\otimes_{S_i}T_i$ on $S\otimes_{S_i}N_i$ extending its usual $S$-action, a submonoid $V\subseteq C$, and an $S$-linear isomorphism $V^{-1}(S\otimes_{S_i}N_i)\cong M$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. No flatness is assumed. For rings in universes $u,v,w$ and module in universe $t$, $I$ and the three stage rings lie in universe $\max(u,v,w)$ and the stage modules in universe $t$.
